title: One Phone Call Brought Down the Hyatt Regency Walkways
description:
How did one phone call bring down two walkways at the Hyatt Regency in Kansas City?
One small change to how the rods held them up doubled the load on a joint that was already weak. We rebuild it in 3D, show the force on the nut, and the moment it gave way.
Sources: NBS (May 1982).
Based on official investigation reports and published sources. 3D scenes are reconstructions, not actual footage.
